edits.value_json: 四 means “four.” The current graph visibly encloses inner 儿-form strokes within 囗. One account describes Shang 亖 as directly representing four alongside forms written 四; some 四 forms are interpreted as counting rods. Other proposals say 四 was a breath-related graph for 呬, later borrowed for “four” because of sound similarity, or the original graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”), later borrowed for “four.” The breath referent’s ancient name is unknown, and the 泗 proposal lacks textual attestation.
